game.name: Deus Ex : Human Revolution (France)
game.desc: Deus Ex: Human Revolution on Xbox 360 is a FPS / role-playing game, prequel to the two previous episodes. You play as Adam Jensen, an employee of a company specialising in biotechnology. Following an attack on the company by a mysterious commando, your investigation begins and will lead you through the typical cyberpunk universe of the series. Freedom of action and choices with scenaristic consequences are the order of the day in this opus.
